_comment: External MCP client configuration for the 'Permis d'agir' server.
where <appId> is the ari:cloud:ecosystem::app/<uuid> written in manifest.yml
by 'forge create' or 'forge register'. Authentication is OAuth 2.1 and an
administrator must enable external exposure for the installation first.
Tools run with the rights of the user who authorized the client, which is
what makes 'the pilot cannot approve their own request' enforceable.
See docs/VALIDATIONS.md item 1 and the Rovo MCP module reference.
agentInstructions: Call check-permission before any action beyond reading, with the issue key,
the announced class and the exact target.
On 'deny' with a requestId: stop, announce the request number, and wait for
the pilot. Never poll get-request-status in a loop.
After acting, call declare-action so the chained ledger stays complete.
Cite the permit in the commit message: 'Permis-Agent: PA-2026-000417'.
